mapper.select: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_subtotal), 1) AS top10Subtotal FROM ( SELECT gb_DPG_dis_goods_id, ROUND(SUM(gb_DPG_buy_subtotal), 1) AS total_subtotal FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods WHERE gb_DPG_stock_finish_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{stopDate} AND gb_DPG_distributer_id = #{disId} AND gb_DPG_status > 2 AND gb_DPG_buy_subtotal > 0 GROUP BY gb_DPG_dis_goods_id ORDER BY total_subtotal DESC LIMIT 10 ) t
